title: JsAnimationTimeline document v2
description: A timeline animation document (Flash CS4 motion-tween model). Frames are absolute and 1-based. Semantic invariants that JSON Schema cannot express (unique ids, contiguous spans, keyframes inside their span...) are checked by validateDocument() in the runtime package; see schema/README.md.

TimelineDocument.description: Root object of a timeline document.

version.description: Format version (semver, major 2). The current version is "2.0.0".

layers.description: Top-level layer tree, first item displayed on top.

TimelineSettings.description: Global timing settings of the document.

fps.description: Frame rate in frames per second.

totalFrames.description: Length of the timeline in frames (frames are numbered 1..totalFrames).

Id.description: Identifier, unique across the whole document (layers, folders and spans).

LayerNode.description: A node of the layer tree: a layer or a folder, discriminated by "type".

Layer.description: A layer: animates a single target through a list of contiguous spans.

color.description: Layer color in the editor (outline color in Flash).

locked.description: Locked against edits in the editor.

icon.description: Layer icon: a built-in icon name, a CSS class or a URL (interpreted by the editor).

target.description: Object animated by the layer: a CSS selector or a reference resolved by a stage, told apart by their key.

spans.description: Spans covering the layer from frame 1, sorted and contiguous (may be empty).

Folder.description: A folder grouping other layers and folders.

locked.description: Locked against edits in the editor.

collapsed.description: Children hidden in the layer tree.

children.description: Child nodes, first item displayed on top.

SelectorTarget.description: Target resolved with a CSS selector in the root of the HTML stage.

selector.description: CSS selector of the animated element.

RefTarget.description: Target resolved by a stage from a developer-chosen reference (canvas object, audio channel, data-timeline-target...).

ref.description: Reference of the animated object, interpreted by the stage.

stage.description: Id of the only stage allowed to resolve the reference (any stage that accepts it when absent).

SpanKind.description: Span kind: "static" (content keyframe, no motion), "blank" (target hidden) or "tween" (motion tween).

Span.description: A frame range [start, end] of a layer starting with a content keyframe.

end.description: Last frame of the span (inclusive, >= start).

easing.description: Easing applied to the whole span (tween spans only).

tracks.description: Property keyframes (static and tween spans only).

PropertyTracks.description: Keyframes per animatable property name (CSS or not; property names are not checked against a registry here).

propertyNames.description: Property name: letters and digits, starting with a letter; "constructor" and "prototype" are reserved.

additionalProperties.description: Keyframes of one property, strictly increasing frames inside the span.

PropertyKeyframe.description: Value of one property at one frame.

frame.description: Absolute, 1-based frame number of the keyframe.

Easing.description: CSS easing: a preset name or cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2). Defaults to "linear".
